title: Behind a gateway, requests fail with a max_tokens error after upgrading to 2.1.329 because the automatic retry is gone
symptoms: API error mentioning max_tokens exceeding the model's output limit
Requests that worked on 2.1.326 through 2.1.328 now fail on a gateway whose model allows fewer output tokens
cause: Version 2.1.326 added an automatic retry that read the limit from a max_tokens error and resent with it. Version 2.1.329 removed that retry, so the oversized max_tokens value is sent and rejected every time.
fix: Set CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS to the output token limit of the model behind the gateway.
apply: export CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS=8192  # use your gateway model's real output limit
affected: Claude Code 2.1.329 and later, with gateways or custom base URLs whose model accepts fewer output tokens than the default
